text: Theorems 7.1 and 7.2 cover debaters that first propose a polynomial-size witness w: for L in NP^O with a time-T verifier there is an (O(T), O(l log T), O(1))-debate protocol with cross-examination that deterministically decides L given w, and for L in MA^O with a K-Lipschitz verifier there is an (O(K^2 T log T), O(K^2 + l log T), O(K^2)) protocol with completeness 3/5 and soundness 2/5.
title: Theorems 7.1-7.2: doubly-efficient debate when the prover supplies a witness (NP^O, MA^O)
